branches.general: A.R.S. §44-1201(B): lesser of 10% or Federal Reserve H.15 prime plus one point, fixed at entry
branches.obligation_written_agreement_and_medical: A.R.S. §44-1201(A) governs qualifying obligations and written agreements and supplies the medical-debt cap
branches.barred_prejudgment_categories: A.R.S. §44-1201(D) bars prejudgment interest for listed unliquidated, future, punitive, and exemplary damages
branches.awarded_prejudgment: A.R.S. §44-1201(F) directs an awarded prejudgment rate to subsection A or B
branches.entitlement: Prejudgment interest entitlement and its accrual date remain claim-specific
